summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandfather; contadino of Guardia Lombardi who married twice.
bio: Tree: Gaetano di Marino (1795-1876) + Maria d'Ambrosio; parents Pietro Dimarino (1760-1808) + Felicia Magnotta (1760-1808). Round 3: died March 1876 (registered 6 Mar), Guardia, aged 80 (so born c.1796), contadino; son of the late Pietro and the late Felicita Magnotta; 'marito di Caterina di Leo'; Morti 1876 act 20. Two wives (probable): first Maria d'Ambrosio (mother of Concetta, who married Giuseppe Petriello on 26 Dec 1855, index 1855 #23), then Caterina di Leo (mother of Grazia and probably of Maria, who married Nicola di Pietro 12 Feb 1857). The tree conflated the wives by making Maria d'Ambrosio Grazia's mother.
openQuestions: Both marriage acts (pre-1855; Guardia civil registers from 1809)
